description_en: Queries whether the managed anti-ransomware service supports automatic configuration of anti-ransomware server backup policies
description_zh: 查询是否支持防勒索托管服务自动配置防勒索服务器备份策略
name: GetBackupAutoConfigStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder (Alibaba Cloud account).
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to retrieve this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

CanConfigAuto.description_en:
Specifies whether the managed configuration of anti-ransomware backup policies is supported. Valid values:
false: Not supported.
true: Supported
CanConfigAuto.description_zh:
是否支持托管配置防勒索备份策略。取值：
false：不支持
true：支持

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
